subject.title: fix(zai): send user agent during endpoint detection

question: Should this PR remain blocked on redacted live Z.AI Coding Plan endpoint-detection proof, or may maintainers waive that proof gap for this narrow source-level fix?
rationale: The patch is narrow and source-backed, but the reported failure depends on real Z.AI edge behavior and contributors do not have a redacted Coding Plan key; automation cannot supply the missing credential proof.
